headline: Volvo expands Nvidia partnership for automated driving
summary: Volvo is expanding its nearly decade-long partnership with Nvidia to power a Level 2++ hands-free, point-to-point driving system targeted for 2030, extending beyond its battery electric vehicles.

claims.statement: Volvo is expanding its Nvidia partnership to power a hands-free, point-to-point automated driving system.

sources.quote: Volvo will use Nvidia’s tech for hands-free, point-to-point driving
Volvo makes a bigger bet on Nvidia
Volvo is leveling up its automated driving system through an expansion of its nearly decade-long partnership with Nvidia

claims.statement: Volvo plans to launch the hands-free, point-to-point driving system by 2030.

sources.quote: Volvo plans to launch hands-free, point-to-point driving by 2030, powered by Nvidia's latest AI technology

claims.statement: The new system will be Level 2++ automation, similar to Tesla's Full Self-Driving (Supervised).

sources.quote: a new partially automated driving system similar to Tesla's Full Self-Driving (Supervised)

Volvo plans to launch hands-free, point-to-point driving by 2030, powered by Nvidia's latest AI technology. The Chinese-owned, Swedish-designed automaker said Thursday it would use Nvidia's autonomous driving stack to power a new partially automated driving system similar to Tesla's Full Self-Driving (Supervised). Volvo says the new point-to-point system will be Level 2++

claims.statement: The expanded Nvidia partnership will extend beyond Volvo's battery electric vehicles.

sources.quote: Volvo is leveling up its automated driving system through an expansion of its nearly decade-long partnership with Nvidia that will extend beyond its battery electric vehicles.
